The Dairy Maid

This is the setting I play. It’s based on Planxty’s version because that’s where I first heard it, but I’ve messed around with the 2nd half of the second part a bit. I like to make it move around the octave a bit more, outlining the chords of Bm and G more obviously through the melody:

AF~F2 AFBF|AFDE FE~E2|AF~F2 BFAF|EADE FDD2|
AF~F2 AFBF|AFDE FEEF|~G3E F2AF|EADE FDD2||
~d3f ~a3g|f2ef dB~B2|dcdf a2fa|bgeg fddA|
dfaf g2ag|f2eg fBBA|GBdf gbag|faeg fedB||

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on September 16th, 2003.

The dairy maid reel

In my local session, we play ‘The Dairy Maid’ as a double reel. Having heard it played both as a single reel and a double reel, I actually prefer it as a double reel.

The Dairy Maid, X:10

This setting is from the playing of Johnny Leary as recorded by Breandán Breathnach on February 22nd, 1973 in Ballydesmond. It’s the version in the Terry Moylan book Johnny Leary of Sliabh Luachra (number 21).
